stage_name_zh: 阶段 2：准确表达、一词多义辨析与时序/AI 基础句法（Day 26–50）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 27 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G015】分词短语（现在分词与过去分词）作后置定语与状语及悬垂修饰防范；【G020】语态的语篇决策：基于研究对象、旧信息前置与施事责任的主动/被动选择。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP002】精确区分可数样本量与不可数开销/证据，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 分词短语（现在分词与过去分词）作后置定语与状语及悬垂修饰防范
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 分词短语能将冗长的从句浓缩为紧凑的后置定语或状语；但句首分词短语的逻辑主语必须与主句主语完全一致，绝不可产生悬垂修饰（Dangling Modifier）。
rules: 后置分词定语：records exceeding the limit (= that exceed...)；predictions compared with ground-truth labels (= that are compared...)。
句首分词状语主语一致铁律：Using a 48-step look-back window, the model reduces MSE（the model 可以 use window；但不能写 *Using a 48-step window, the MSE decreases，因为 MSE 不会自己 use window！）。
examples: Records exceeding the stated size limit were excluded.
Compared with earlier studies, this study used a larger sample.
Halving the sampling interval doubles the sampling frequency.
common_errors: 悬垂分词：*Training on synthetic data, the generalization error remained high（应改为 When the model was trained on synthetic data, ... 或 Training on synthetic data left the model with high generalization error）。

grammar_instruction.name: 语态的语篇决策：基于研究对象、旧信息前置与施事责任的主动/被动选择
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 破除“被动语态一定比主动语态更学术”的迷思。语态选择服务于：(1) 维持句间话题链连贯（把上句提到的受事对象作为本句被动主语，满足 Given-before-New），(2) 明确谁对设计决策或核验承担责任。
rules: 当描述标准化数据清洗、传感器部署或客观流程，且受事对象是段落主题时，选用被动语态（The records are arranged in chronological order before the time-series analysis）。
当阐述本文核心创新设计、范围限定决策或强调多名标注者独立操作时，选用主动语态（We confine the analysis to...; Two analysts analysed the data independently; The algorithm exploits the sparsity of the matrix）。
examples: Passive for topic continuity: The predictions are compared with ground-truth labels that were checked by two annotators.
Active for clear methodological agency: We reformulate the constrained problem as an equivalent optimization problem.
common_errors: 通篇机械使用被动语态导致语句冗长、施事责任模糊（如分不清是前人文献做的还是本文做的）。

grammar_instruction.name: 去除“AI 味（Anti-AI-ese）”与过度修辞：用具体机制、指标与实例替代空洞夸张
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 典型 AI 生成文本充斥着空洞的套话与浮夸副词/形容词（如 delve into, testament to, tapestry, underscores the paramount importance, revolutionize, unparalleled, groundbreaking），却缺乏具体技术细节。地道顶会论文（NeurIPS/ICLR/CoRL）与高分雅思/托福/六级写作追求“低修辞密度、高信息密度”：用具体动词、明确指标和真实实例说话。
rules: 删除无实质信息的“清嗓子”套话（Throat-clearing）：少用 *It is worth noting that / It is undeniable that / In the realm of modern artificial intelligence*，直接陈述事实主干。

禁止“只有夸张形容词而不给实例或数据支撑”：不要写 *The model achieves an enormous, unparalleled improvement*，而要写 *The proposed parametrization reduces MSE by 8.4% relative to the seasonal naive baseline on hourly electricity demand*。
优先选用朴素、精准的单音节或核心学术动词（examine, test, compare, constrain, decompose, bound, mitigate）替代故作高深的修辞词。
examples:
AI 腔/空洞夸张：*This groundbreaking paradigm delves into the intricate tapestry of temporal dynamics and achieves unparalleled accuracy.*
地道学术改写：*This model decomposes the series into trend and seasonal components, achieving lower forecasting error than the linear baseline on three benchmarks.*

六级/雅思空洞句：*Technology has an enormous impact on education in many ways.*
地道具体展开：*Asynchronous learning platforms allow part-time students to review lecture recordings at their own pace, reducing scheduling conflicts.*
common_errors: 堆砌 paramount, unprecedented, revolutionize, multifaceted 等宣传式词汇，违反客观学术语域。
只下宏大判断（如 *This method is very efficient*）而不给出具体的计算复杂度、内存占用或延迟数据。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 精确区分可数样本量与不可数开销/证据
expression_pattern_instruction.template: While a large number of [plural countable nouns] were collected, the procedure required only a small amount of [uncountable noun].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 在数据集与实验开销描述中准确搭配可数与不可数量词。
examples: A large number of records still require checking.
The protocol requires a small amount of additional information.
common_errors: *a great deal of participants / *an amount of records。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 描述系统模块、数据集或分类体系的构成
expression_pattern_instruction.template: [Whole System/Dataset] consists of / comprises [N] components, whereas [Subset] accounts for / constitutes [Proportion].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用主动语态的 consist of / comprise 表整体由部分组成，用 constitute / account for 表部分占整体的比例。
examples: The questionnaire consists of three sections.
Missing responses account for a small proportion of the records.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 复数 figures 在数据分析中常指“具体统计数字”。 | 词表跨单元多义对比：[V01023 n.] 图；插图（例：Figure 1 summarises the study design.）；[V01024 n.] 数字；数值（例：The report gives the figures for each district.）
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The report gives the figures for each district.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V01026 adj.] 最后的（例：The final stage involves independent review.）；[V01027 adj.] 最后的；最终的（例：The final point concerns the limits of the comparison.） | 本条用法约束：final 表示序列的末阶段。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The final stage involves independent review.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V01026 adj.] 最后的（例：The final stage involves independent review.）；[V01027 adj.] 最后的；最终的（例：The final point concerns the limits of the comparison.） | 本条用法约束：final通常比last正式；不表示经过长久等待。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The final point concerns the limits of the comparison.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：名词 finances 指个人财务状况，通常复数。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The scholarship will help finance her studies.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：题目中的 find 可要求计算；不必然是搜索。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Find the value of the unknown parameter from the equation.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：列举开头；不是描述后来改变的 at first。
学术语境与搭配约束：可数名词；flaws in。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A flaw in the design allowed test observations into training.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：此处与thrive接近；保留may，不承诺所有小组均有同样结果。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Discussion may flourish in a group that allows careful questioning.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：不及物动词：prices/demand fluctuate；名词 fluctuation。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Travel times fluctuate over the school year.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：名词 the focus of；动词 focus on。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The focus of the review is access to public transport.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：force somebody to do。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The missing records forced the team to revise its plan.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：名词foreignness；不能仅凭foreign推断不合规范或不合理。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The diary describes encounters with unfamiliar customs in a foreign country.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：词义不同于 design；根据宾语选择。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The pilot study helped us form a testable hypothesis.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：正式程度应服从准确和清楚，不能机械地换成长词。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: This phrase is suitable for formal writing.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：词族 formulation；不表示假设已经证实。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The protocol formulates a testable hypothesis.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V01074 adj.] 即将到来的（例：The correction will appear in the forthcoming issue.）；[V01075 adj.] 即将到来的；即将发表的（例：The article will appear in the forthcoming issue.） | 本条用法约束：指将来即将发生或出版，不是当前。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The correction will appear in the forthcoming issue.
